_about: Changes from 0.98a to 0.98.5a, merged onto 0.98a.json. Built by scripts/build-defs-0985a.cjs from the 0.98.5a API sources and game data; see docs/GAME-0.98.5a-ASSESSMENT.md (R3).

ruleCommands.name: RepIsAtWorst
ruleCommands.summary: True if the player's standing is at least the level: with a faction, or (0.98.5a) with a person id, or with one argument the active person (else the entity's faction).

ruleCommands.name: RepIsAtBest
ruleCommands.summary: True if the player's standing is at most the level: with a faction, or (0.98.5a) with a person id, or with one argument the active person (else the entity's faction).

ruleCommands.name: RepGTE
ruleCommands.summary: Same as RepIsAtWorst (a subclass): standing at least the level.

ruleCommands.name: RepLTE
ruleCommands.summary: Same as RepIsAtBest (a subclass): standing at most the level.

ruleCommands.name: SetPersonHidden
ruleCommands.summary: Hides or shows a person in their market's comm directory; with only the true/false argument (0.98.5a), the active person.

ruleCommands.name: MovePersonToMarket
ruleCommands.summary: Moves a person to a market (default: current); 0.98.5a: a third argument true also lists them in the comm directory.

ruleCommands.name: PersonCMD
ruleCommands.summary: Marks a person important or unimportant (the quest-giver marker; the reason defaults to "generic"), or (isContact) true if the person is a contact. Without a person id: the active person. With two or more arguments the second one is always read as a person id.

ruleCommands.name: HasContactFromFaction
ruleCommands.summary: True if the player has an active contact from the faction. vipBlacklist true ignores major story characters (Reynard Hannan, Horus Yaribay, Arroyo, Faro Inesis, Rao, Glamor Rotanev).

ruleCommands.name: MarketHasIndustry
ruleCommands.summary: True if the interaction target's market has any of the listed industries (ids from industries.csv).

ruleCommands.name: PersonIsDefaultMarketPost
ruleCommands.summary: True if the person (default: active person) holds a standard market post: administrator, supply officer, base or station commander, portmaster.

ruleCommands.name: ShowPlayerPerson
ruleCommands.summary: Shows the player character in the visual panel.

ruleCommands.name: FinishVisualFadeFast
ruleCommands.summary: Ends a running fade of the visual panel at once.

ruleCommands.name: SellToFleet
ruleCommands.summary: Selling salvage to a fleet that buys it (scavengers): willBuyStuff = true if the fleet will buy, selectStuff = open the selection.

ruleCommands.name: SDR_CMD
ruleCommands.summary: Sindrian Diktat storyline helper (multi-purpose; vanilla story only).
